column5: The common reader decodes each declared source cell exactly once, before any wire, CEL or native interpretation, and encodes the resulting string as UTF-8. It never decodes that string recursively. For example, source `\\\\\u0436\"` produces the six literal ASCII characters `\\u0436`; source `\"\\u0436\"` produces one Unicode scalar. A later JSON interpretation required by an existing column's wire form is unchanged; it is separate from this source step. Comments are not data and the marker is not sent to the implementation. No request, case identifier or physical source line number changes."

Physical table rows are separated by LF only and cells by TAB only. U+2028 and U+000B within an undeclared cell remain part of that same cell and physical row. File reading performs no universal-newline normalization: an undeclared U+000D is retained too. No other Unicode line separator is interpreted as a source row boundary.

[unmarked-sha256.tsv](../vectors/source-cells/unmarked-sha256.tsv) records the source-text identity and equal before/decoded UTF-8 hashes for the U+2028 and U+000B regressions. Each remains one data row at physical line 3; the undeclared cell is unchanged.
